description: Find the public toilets nearest to a set of coordinates, using data from the National Public Toilet Map. Useful for finding the closest toilet, the closest accessible toilet or the nearest RV dump point. Returns toilets sorted by distance, each with name, address, distance, opening hours, facilities (wheelchair access, baby change, RV dump point, showers, drinking water and more) and a directions link. If none fall inside radius_km, the closest ones are still returned.

radius_km.description: Search radius in km (default 15). If none are within radius, the closest are returned anyway.

name: find_nearest_toilets
title: Find nearest public toilets
